615-Sec1Christmas2025.ja: Let's enjoy Christmas today. It is good. I truly believe that.Admiral、飲んでる？いい気分だわ。
615-Sec1Christmas2025.zh: 今天一起来享受圣诞节吧。我相信一定会是个好日子哦。提督，有在喝吗？气氛真好啊。

615-Sec1Valentine2026.ja: Japan's unique Valentine's Day season has arrived. I've prepared some killer chocolates for you.
615-Sec1Valentine2026.zh: 日本独特的情人节到了。我为你准备了些必杀巧克力哦。

615-Sec1Shinnen2026.ja: Happy New Year! Admiral! I hope you will continue to support the Essex class aircraft carriers this year.
615-Sec1Shinnen2026.zh: 新年快乐，提督。请您今年也多多关照我们埃塞克斯级航空母舰。
